record.kind: OnResurrectionEffect (shared instance) that re-applies the blade-form stat deltas; the form toggle itself lives in the KING_SHIELD ability
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.AEGISLASH] holds a single OnResurrectionEffect. It runs as the last step of PokemonEntity.resurrect(), after attack, DEF, SPE_DEF (and other stats) were overwritten with values rebuilt from the board pokemon. If the entity's current name is AEGISLASH_BLADE at that moment, it requests +10 attack, -5 DEF and -5 SPE_DEF on itself (apBoost 0, no crit, not permanent) so that the blade-form deltas, which the rebuild wiped, are applied again; for a unit named AEGISLASH it does nothing. The form change itself is not in this passive: KING_SHIELD, when the caster has passive AEGISLASH, schedules a 1500 ms delayed command that toggles between the two forms (+10 / -5 / -5 into the blade, the reverse back) and renames the entity. The only caller of resurrect() found in app/core is Simulation.onFinish for entities of the winning team that carry status.resurrecting, so this passive acts at the end of a fight, not mid-fight.
triggers: PokemonEntity.resurrect() (called from Simulation.onFinish for winning-team entities with status.resurrecting) applies every OnResurrectionEffect
KING_SHIELD cast with passive AEGISLASH: delayed form toggle (outside the passive file; separate ability record)

effects.declaredRaw: +10 attack, -5 DEF, -5 SPE_DEF requested on itself, only when the entity name is AEGISLASH_BLADE
effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false with the caster being the unit itself: no AP or crit factor (Math.round of the value). Each adder then runs applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff. Big Eater Belt: the +10 attack becomes +12 (10 x 1.25 = 12.5 rounded down); the -5 DEF / -5 SPE_DEF are negative changes from a caster on the holder's own team (the unit itself), so a Belt holder gets them multiplied by 1.25 too (rounded with the 'down' mode; the direction of that rounding for negative numbers was not traced, so the exact applied value, -6 or -7, is not stated). Twist Band does not flip them because the caster is on the holder's own team. The shared references (core-mechanics §I, item-effects.md TWIST_BAND / BIG_EATER_BELT) were consulted for the helper behaviour.
effects.resolution: requested +10 / -5 / -5; applied after the helpers and the floors: attack min 1, DEF min 0, SPE_DEF min 0 (a rebuilt DEF or SPE_DEF below 5 would stop at 0 instead of going negative). permanent is false, so the board pokemon is not changed; only the fight entity is.

effects.declaredRaw: effect body runs only if pokemon.name === Pkm.AEGISLASH_BLADE
effects.resolution: name is the entity's current name. resurrect() overwrites stats from the rebuilt clone but never writes name or index, so a blade-form entity keeps its blade name through the rebuild and receives the deltas again; a shield-form entity is left at the rebuilt (shield) stats.

conditions: Only if the entity's name is AEGISLASH_BLADE at that moment

record.resetBehaviour: The effect instance is stateless (no counter). The form deltas it re-applies are not permanent (permanent = false) and live only on the fight entity; the rebuild in resurrect() overwrites atk / def / speDef from the board pokemon before the effect runs. The form name persists on the entity; whether a new fight starts from the board pokemon's own name is not traced here.
